decisive_items: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del) identified by whole-exon sequencing
response.rationale: Genetic testing revealed a pathogenic variant of the TBK1 gene, which is a specific indicator of frontotemporal dementia and parkinsonism-17, outweighing the clinical features that could suggest progressive supranuclear palsy

rejected.why: Lack of specific genetic marker for progressive supranuclear palsy
